claim: Platform framework for business apps: Chat, Project Management, CRM, HRM and ATS; Huly is built on it
Self-hosting through huly-selfhost with docker compose; Kubernetes sample under kube
Minimum 2 vCPUs and 8 GB RAM; recommended 4 vCPUs and 16 GB
Review MIGRATION.md before updating; 0.6.x to 0.7.x needs dedicated migration steps
Production versions use v tags; typed API client available
Hosted Huly service is being discontinued; self-hosted deployments not affected
Development prerequisites: Node.js v22, Docker, Docker Compose
Licence EPL-2.0 as recorded in project data; GitHub API lists EPL-2.0
